messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - gpu-prefill OOM on cluster-gamma. Affected service: runtime/prefill (multiple containers restarting). Pager routed to sara.

sara (oncall): on it, joining bridge. any immediate customer impact?

jamal: customers seeing streaming failures and reconnects, a few 500s. looks like long-chat customers hit large context windows.

mei: logs show repeated CUDA OOM during prefill path, then container restart loop. snippet: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.17 GiB (GPU 0; 23.70 GiB total capacity; 21.50 GiB already allocated; 512.00 MiB free)
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] container: runtime-pool-8 restart (OOM)
```

ben (infra): node metrics show swap spikes and kernel msgs around the same time, node-gamma-12 had a brief NIC flail earlier. could be fragmentation + noisy batch.

mei: yes - pattern: a single request with ~1.2M tokens in the prompt batch triggered prefill to allocate huge KV cache, fragmentation prevented reuse, OOM. we hit container restart loop because restart backoff wasn't preventing immediate re-schedule.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) scale down prefill concurrency on cluster-gamma to 1; 2) enable safe-prefill-throttle config for runtime/prefill; 3) cordon node-gamma-12 to stop new pods scheduling. executing now.

jamal: applied throttle via ops-bot: `ops-bot: set runtime.prefill.max_concurrency=1 --scope cluster-gamma`  — confirmed on API. also triggered KV cache trim for running containers.

ops-bot: Config applied. KV cache trim command issued to runtime-pool-*.

ben (infra): cordoned node-gamma-12 and drained non-critical pods. evicted the problematic pod; replacing it with a fresh scheduler will use a smaller prefill window.

mei: rolling restart avoided now. we patched restart policy to include a 30s backoff to avoid hot loops while we triage. also added a quick guard to reject single-request token counts > 500k on prefill path (soft-fail).

kate (support): drafting customer message: "We observed an elevated error rate for long-context generation on cluster-gamma between 09:10-09:30 UTC. Root cause: large prefill requests caused GPU OOM and container restarts; mitigations applied and errors are declining. If you saw failures, please retry now." want me to post to status?

sara (oncall): yes please post with note that ongoing monitoring for 1 hour. set status to degraded for runtime/prefill in cluster-gamma.

jamal: adding postmortem tickets: tag infra for node NIC flaps, runtime team for prefill allocation fragmentation, devex for guidance on large prompt limits.

mei: follow-ups: 1) investigate kernel-level fragmentation and potential cudaMalloc trimming strategies; 2) add explicit preflight token-count check in gateway; 3) improve metrics to show KV cache allocation per-request.

ben (infra): also recommend adding a CSI quiesce for nodes under swap pressure and alert on kernel messages that precede OOMs.

ops-bot: Incident acknowledged as SEV2. Runbook step: notify customer-facing teams, apply throttles, cordon affected nodes, collect debug bundle.

sara (oncall): debug bundle uploaded to /tmp/incident-7490012345, will hand off to daytime oncall (jamal) in 30m for longer remediation. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

jamal: adding note — customer impact window 09:10-09:28 UTC, approx 18 minutes, estimated 120 requests affected by prefill failures. saving logs and linking to ticket.

kate (support): posted status update and added note to customer ticket queue.

mei: leaving a short-term mitigation patch in staging to reject >1M token batch requests; will PR later today.

sara (oncall): closing pager for now; monitoring. escalate if error rate >1% for next 15m.
